name: @weasel-rs/sdk-as
description: AssemblyScript SDK and sample theme for weasel-rs WASM themes

scripts.asbuild: npm run asbuild:debug && npm run asbuild:release && npm run asbuild:quickstart && npm run asbuild:animated && npm run asbuild:layer-pulse
